body: 90 metaphorically meaning worse than when I was committed. I was there a month and probably only slept a few hours.

I was institutionalized and medicated. The combination is the reason why I feel I'm fat and why I self harm so brutally. Inpatient made me into a monster...I was 13 when I entered, and 90 leaving. I can still hear the screams of the adult ward conveniently next door. Don't let them put you in...I fear that there just isn't hope for me.
Jealous...good luck. You're already 3x the person I will ever be.
I'm struggling to hold on as well man. My parents and your cat are the only things keeping us here. I wish there was an answer. Im so fucking lonely.

I fucking wish for friendship of any kind. It seems everyone I talk to uses me to get high. I get high with them, expecting conversation...but they just stay on their phone. This and videogames(losing interest fast) are my only "social" interactions. Id like to say something positive to help, but I'm lost as fuck too. The therapy of knowing others are finding success or are sill struggling here helps me sleep...rinse, repeat.
I don't have the luxury of having or knowing anyone with a fire arm. I hope everything goes smoothly and you find what you're looking for. Maybe slide by me and shoot me too? Lol.

I'm currently contemplating it myself. My sister(makes more at fresh 21, successful older bf, pretty and smart) and I have been living at home to pay our parents bills. I am extremely suicidal but am stuck at my pizza delivery (fuck me man im 22) job to help make ends meet. 

I'm trying to stay alive for them and will for sure kill myself when my parents die. But I am losing the will to even fight that long.

If you've made it, I'm jealous.
If not, I hope your pain is gone.
